title: See what can run in parallel from mapped dependencies
statement: As an architect, I can break a Plan into Tasks with their dependencies mapped, so the team and its agents can see what can run in parallel and what must wait.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Plan has a set of Tasks, and each Task belongs to one Plan.
A Task's page lists both the Tasks it depends on and the Tasks it blocks.
A Plan's dependency graph shows which Tasks that are not done can start now because everything they depend on is done.
